name: delivery
description: Define Delivery pipelines, stages, jobs and sources in a Pulumi program.

delivery:index:ProgramSource.description: Location of the pipeline program in a repository.

directory.description: Directory that contains the Pulumi.yaml of the pipeline, relative to the repository root.

source.description: VCS source of the pipeline program.

delivery:index:Rule.description: Rule that a release must pass to enter a stage. A rule can contain other rules, up to three levels deep.

approvers.description: Pulumi usernames or team names in the organization. If the list is empty, anyone with the organization update permission can approve.

body.description: HTTP request body. Secret values stay secret.

count.description: Number of approvals required. If you omit it or set it to zero, one approval is required. Applies to approval rules.

description.description: Text for the person who continues a manual gate, for example what to check first.

headers.description: HTTP request headers. Secret values stay secret.

headersEnvironment.description: Name of an ESC environment that exports values.headers. Delivery sends these headers first, then the headers of the rule.

interval.description: Time between HTTP requests, as a Go duration, such as 1m. Use a whole number of seconds. The minimum is 60 seconds.

kind.description: Kind of the rule. Valid values are approval, http, manual, all, and any.

method.description: HTTP request method. The default is GET.

name.description: Rule name. Omit it to let Delivery assign one.

rules.description: Child rules for all and any rules. At least one is required.

successExpression.description: JMESPath expression that Delivery evaluates on the status, headers and body of the HTTP response. The rule passes when the result is true. Required for http rules.

timeout.description: Timeout of each HTTP request, as a Go duration, such as 10s. Use a whole number of seconds from 1 to 20.

url.description: URL to call. Required for http rules.

delivery:index:SourceTrigger.description: Limits the pushes that start a run.

paths.description: Glob patterns of changed files. A push starts a run only when it changes a file that matches one of them.

delivery:index:StacksEntry.description: One target stack that a Stacks resource updates.

config.description: Config values that Delivery sets on the target stack before the update. Values are plain strings. Delivery rejects secret values. Keep secrets in the config file of the target stack or in an ESC environment.

directory.description: Directory of the stack project, relative to the repository root.

environment.description: Environment variables for the update, for example cloud credentials. Secret values stay secret. The names PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN and PULUMI_BACKEND_URL, and all names that start with DELIVERY_, are reserved.

runtime.description: Pool that runs the update. In the private preview, all work runs on the hosted pool, so omit it.

source.description: VCS source to check out. The update uses the commit of the run for this source.

stack.description: Target stack as organization/project/stack. It must exist before the first run, in the organization of the pipeline.

timeout.description: Maximum run time of the update in seconds. The default is 7200 (2 hours).

delivery:index:WorkflowsRuntimeArgs.description: Pool selection. In the private preview, all work runs on the hosted pool.

agentPool.description: Pool identifier. The resource returns it unchanged as ref.

value.description: Value to publish. It can be any value, including a secret or a structure.

delivery:index:AzureDevOpsSource.description: Declares an Azure DevOps repository and branch. See GitHubSource.

commit.description: Commit of the run for this source. It is unknown during registration and preview.

repository.description: Repository of the source. Use `owner/repo` on GitHub, `group/subgroup/repo` (the full path) on GitLab, `workspace/repo` on Bitbucket and `org/project/repo` on Azure DevOps. Pulumi Cloud picks the integration of the organization whose account (GitHub), group (GitLab), workspace (Bitbucket) or organization and project (Azure DevOps) holds the repository.

trigger.description: Starts a run when someone pushes to the branch. Set true for every push, or { paths } for pushes that change a matching file. If you omit it, the source is part of the release but never starts a run.

delivery:index:Job.description:
Declares a command that a run executes in a stage. Delivery checks out the source at the commit of the run and runs the command in directory.

A resource that is not a Delivery resource waits for the job when it uses an output of the job.

The command can read these variables: DELIVERY_RELEASE, DELIVERY_RUN, DELIVERY_STAGE, DELIVERY_COMMIT and DELIVERY_PIPELINE. To publish outputs, write a JSON object to the file that DELIVERY_OUTPUTS names. Each key is one output. The file can be at most 1 MiB. To mark an output as secret, write it as {"value": ..., "secret": true}.

If one output is secret, the whole map is secret. An output is secret when the job marks it as secret or when it contains a secret environment value.

## Example Usage

```typescript
import * as delivery from "@pulumi/delivery";

new delivery.Job("smoke", {
    stage: prod,
    source: code,
    directory: "delivery",
    command: "./scripts/smoke.sh",
});
```

outputs.description: Outputs that the command wrote. They are unknown until the job runs.

command.description: Command to run with sh -c. To publish outputs, the command writes them to the file that DELIVERY_OUTPUTS names.

directory.description: Directory to run the command in, relative to the repository root.

environment.description: Environment variables for the command. Secret values stay secret. The names PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN and PULUMI_BACKEND_URL, and all names that start with DELIVERY_, are reserved.

stage.description: Stage that the job runs in.

timeout.description: Maximum run time as a Go duration, such as 30m. Delivery does not apply this value in the private preview. A job stops after 2 hours.

releaseNumber.description: Number of the release of the run. It is unknown during registration and preview.

program.description: Source and directory of the pipeline program.

artifacts.description: Artifacts of the release, by name.

releaseNumber.description: Number of the release that the stage of the upstream pipeline deployed.

runNumber.description: Number of the run of the upstream pipeline that converged the stage.

trigger.description: Set true to start a run of this pipeline when the stage deploys a new release. If you omit it, the source is part of the release but never starts a run.

outputs.description: Outputs of each entry, by entry name. They are unknown until the group runs.

stacks.description: Entries by name. A name can contain letters, digits, underscores and hyphens. Each entry updates one target stack.

stage.description: Stage that the group runs in.

from.description: Upstream stages. Omit for an entry stage.

pipeline.description: Pipeline that the stage belongs to.

when.description: Optional rule that must pass before the release enters this stage.

delivery:index:WorkflowsRuntime.description: Selects the pool that runs the work of a member. In the private preview, all work runs on the hosted pool, so do not use this resource yet. Agent pools are not available.

agentPool.description: Pool identifier. The resource returns it unchanged as ref.
